The reconstructed page has low readability evidence.
assumptions: Upright strips from one page; missing strips are not identified.

matching.method: full-height edge ink and text-row traces; shared FFT registration and constrained local alignment

verification.pair_score_fallback: All directed pairs remain available. Missing OCR evidence earns no text bonus. OCR-off mode uses all visual scores.
verification.ocr_sampling: Up to 24 text lines distributed over the full height; analysis height capped at 2400 pixels. Final-page OCR reads the complete analysis image.
verification.candidate_selection: Every directed pair is checked. Context search tests swaps, single moves, and moves of groups of up to six strips.

document_check.method: Full-page OCR ink evidence and English word plausibility when enough text is available.
document_check.score_note: Heuristic readability evidence, not an accuracy percentage or proof of a correct order. English word checks only rank candidates; source pixels and OCR text are not corrected.
